title: cross_application_reuse, opt_nonempty, parse_count duplicated verbatim in form_handler and trigger
detail: Three brand-new helpers (cross_application_reuse, opt_nonempty, parse_count; opt_to_str too) are byte-identical across two modules, violating AGENTS.md's 'extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places.' A SQL-signature change forces synchronized edits.
recommended_fix: Move cross_application_reuse + parse_count + opt_nonempty/opt_to_str into a shared module (e.g. reference_checks/contacts.gleam) and import from both call sites.

title: stamp_creation_fraud_signals wholesale-overwrites fraud_signals; manual /start re-fire will clobber RC4.3's referee_contact_invalid
detail: stamp_creation_fraud re-runs on every manual /start (handle_start:444 -> run_create_checks -> create_eligible_slots:209). A wholesale SET wipes any key a later path merges (RC4.3's referee_contact_invalid via jsonb_set). Benign in rc3-7 scope; latent for RC4.3.
recommended_fix: When RC4.3 lands, make stamp_creation_fraud_signals merge (jsonb_set / ||) instead of wholesale SET, or guard the re-stamp to skip rows already carrying referee_contact_invalid.
